content: In today’s highly competitive Forex market, brokers need more than just tight spreads and fast execution—they need investor-focused solutions that drive growth and build long-term trust.
This is where PAMM (Percent Allocation Management Module) and MAM (Multi-Account Manager) systems come into play.

In today’s highly competitive Forex market, brokers need more than just tight spreads and fast execution—they need investor-focused solutions that drive growth and build long-term trust. This is where PAMM (Percent Allocation Management Module) and MAM (Multi-Account Manager) systems come into play.
At FINITIC, we offer a fully integrated PAMM/MAM solution tailored for brokerages aiming to deliver professional asset management services without adding operational complexity.

A PAMM account allows investors to allocate funds to a professional money manager. Trades are executed from a master account, and profits or losses are distributed proportionally to each investor based on their contribution.

content.Best_for: Passive investors seeking a hands-off investment experience.
content.Broker_benefit: Attracts larger deposits and fosters long-term client relationships.

content: A MAM account offers enhanced flexibility. It enables money managers to trade on behalf of multiple clients while customizing risk levels or lot sizes per investor.

content.Best_for: Traders with multiple clients or those offering tailored investment strategies.
content.Broker_benefit: Supports high-volume managers and expands your service capabilities.
